name: Owen O’Keefe
highlight: At 16 the Fermoy swimmer crossed solo in 10h19. Four years later he swam in the six-person Crosóige Mara relay.
biography: Owen O’Keefe swam for Fermoy Swimming Club in County Cork. On 21 September 2009, aged 16, he became the youngest Irish swimmer at the time to complete a solo English Channel crossing. Lance Oram guided him from England to France aboard Sea Satin.

In July 2013 O’Keefe swam the second turn in the six-person Crosóige Mara relay. The team reached France and returned to Shakespeare Beach in 20 hours 29 minutes. Later that summer he swam around Jersey in 9 hours 35 minutes and covered the River Blackwater from Fermoy to Youghal in 12 hours 8 minutes.
The Irish Long Distance Swimming Association also records his 2010 Strait of Gibraltar crossing. He entered the Ireland Marathon Swimming Hall of Fame in its class of 2020.

crossings.title: Solo from England to France, 21 September 2009

lines.label: Result
lines.text: 10 hours 19 minutes, ratified by the CS&PF.

lines.label: Departure and arrival
lines.text: 01:41 from Abbot’s Cliff at the western end of Samphire Hoe. The register gives a 12:00 finish, and Sport Ireland places the landing at Cap Gris-Nez. The register does not specify a time zone.

lines.label: Date discrepancy
lines.text: Sport Ireland calls the swim a Sunday. The federation’s dated record and season table both give Monday 21 September.

lines.label: Escort
lines.text: Pilot Lance Oram, vessel Sea Satin, observer Irene Wakeham and trainer Jackie Power.

lines.label: Record at the time
lines.text: Youngest Irish solo swimmer, aged 16. Accounts differ on his national speed ranking.

lines.label: Team performance
lines.text: Six-person relay from England to France and back in 20:29:00. The official team splits are 10:18:59 and 10:10:01.

lines.label: Route and clocks
lines.text: O’Keefe reports a 01:14 start at Abbot’s Cliff, a French landing south of Cap Gris-Nez and a finish at Shakespeare Beach. The reported start and official duration imply about 21:43. The finish clock is calculated.

lines.label: Team members
lines.text: Carol Cashell, Owen O’Keefe, Caitlin Desmond, Lynne Lynch, Maeve Ryan and Eoin O’Riordan.

lines.label: Escort
lines.text: Mike Oram piloted Gallivant. O’Keefe names the two CS&PF observers as Mike Ball and Jim Boucher.
